preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**6 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The given edges form a valid tree structure (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == str(sum(max(path_values) - min(path_values) for path_values in all_simple_paths(a, edges)))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the difference between the maximum and minimum vertex values for every simple path in the tree.
